narr: Typical summer afternoon thunderstorms affected East Tennessee, but a few strengthened and produced damaging wind gusts that blew down trees. Locally heavy rainfall resulted in flooding.
ev: Up to two feet of water covered roadways near the intersection of Veterans Memorial Drive and Unicoi Lane in Tellico Plains.
Flooded roadways were reported in several places near downtown and southeastern Knoxville.
lsr: 2 FT OF WATER OVER UNICOI LANE AND VETERANS MEMORIAL DRIVE.
MULTIPLE REPORTS OF WATER OVER ROADS NEAR DOWNTOWN KNOXVILLE AND SE KNOXVILLE.
